headline: Policy votes on drug and alcohol testing for transportation employees and tobacco prohibition, plus HVAC work and fund balance updates.
summary: The agenda covers policy adoption and readings on drug and alcohol testing for transportation employees and tobacco prohibition. It also includes HVAC and fund balance updates, a merger committee representative, and an executive session on pending or probable civil litigation.
items: Board presence at the Welcome Back Family BBQ
Discussion of City-WSD joint meeting date (10/19 or 11/02)
Discussion and action on assigning a representative to the Merger Committee
Public hearing and adoption of a policy
Policy B4 Drug and Alcohol Testing of Transportation Employees: second read and approval for adoption
Policy first read of B7 Tobacco Prohibition
Discussion and action on final board retreat agenda
Discussion and action on internal monitoring report
Discussion and action on August Superintendent's Report
Consent agenda: June 10, 2026 meeting minutes, approval of bills, City-WSD MOU, dissolution notice of the Heart of Winooski Foundation
Executive session under 1 V.S.A. § 313 (a) (1) (E) on premature public knowledge and pending or probable civil litigation
